justification: User-facing wording on two cards plus one pure display helper; no data or calculation change

pre_impl.existing_data: constraints.lga from the Planning Portal LGA Name
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a blank name gives a sentence without the name, never an empty one

falsifiable_check.command: jest __tests__/lib/council-display-name.test.ts; page check C5 render-junk on fresh captures
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a sentence again puts 'the' before a council name that starts with THE (C5 doubled word), or the helper stops writing The Hills Shire
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main the live planning tab for 10 Excelsior Ave Castle Hill reads 'developed in the THE HILLS SHIRE area' (capture 2026-10-19, page check C5 render-junk); the new Jest file fails on main (no module).

functions.name: councilDisplayName
functions.input: Portal LGA Name string from constraints.lga
functions.output: title-cased council name for a sentence, or null
functions.if_none: null or blank input returns null and the sentence omits the name

values.if_missing: generic sentence without a council name

break_it.what_happens: the sentence read 'in the THE HILLS SHIRE area'
break_it.how: sentences no longer put an article before the name

break_it.what_happens: the sentence would read with a gap where the name goes
break_it.how: falls back to a sentence without the name
